source.postQualificationChanges: This qualification file and its current-server contract link only.

implementation.selection: Retain the independently selected original server archive and a fresh independently selected current native server/inventory cut; never replace the original with incoming metadata.
implementation.atomicNativeCheck: Under one room-then-assets transaction, require the exact current native files/inventory, actual immutable original native identity, complete original log prefix, every original immutable raster record/manifest and all current protected registrations.
implementation.credentials: Original and later document/review registrations, revoked accounts and permanent observers remain required. Missing records yield Pending only after native continuity; wrong, duplicate, foreign and malformed supplied credentials reject.
implementation.liveProof: VerifiedServerRecoveryContinuation weakly binds one actual host and authenticated owner/current cut. check_live authenticates again and rechecks exact current files/inventory. A changed cut or another/restarted host requires a fresh proof.

originalHeader.detail: The new path initially accepted a correctly checksummed original header naming a false compiler profile over matching real log bytes.
originalHeader.fix: Compare original document, owner, compiler, transport and namespace with the actual native room, not admitted header metadata. Then require the exact original complete log prefix and all original raster records.

serverFeature.detail: The new host-only helper caused strict no-server lint to fail as unused.
serverFeature.fix: Compile the helper only with the optional server feature; add mandatory strict no-server all-target lint and its plan contract to both release profiles.

remaining: This proof checks one native host/current cut at one instant. It creates or verifies no operational marker and reserves no later mutation or activation barrier.
Protected credential custody, current deployment/writer fencing, reconciliation of every historic/offline client copy and complete current provider/reference closure remain activation requirements.
The approved cross-generation Undo/Redo and outstanding offline-edit bridge remains required; neither a history reset nor a limit increase substitutes for it.
Node storage/lock/raster fixtures and production module imports do not qualify browser behavior, process/power-loss durability, quota/eviction or the large-room operating envelope.
All 13 V1 release gates remain open. Historical WebKit is not confirmed fixed; physical Japanese input and VoiceOver qualification remain deferred.
The existing capped vendored dependency warning, generic-btree notice gap and complete dependency/license approval remain unresolved. No push, tag, publication or deployment occurred.
